terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.html:
1. Quotations

A quotation is valid for the period stated on it, or 7 days if none is stated. Prices exclude VAT and other taxes unless stated. Quotations depend on supplier availability and on exchange rates and freight costs at the time of quoting. We may correct obvious errors before accepting an order.

2. Orders and payment

An order is accepted when we confirm it in writing. Unless a credit account has been agreed in writing, goods are paid for in advance or against a pro-forma invoice. Special-order items may require a deposit, which is non-refundable once the item has been ordered from the supplier, unless the supplier cancels. Overdue amounts may attract interest at a reasonable rate and recovery costs.

3. Fitment and specifications

You are responsible for giving correct equipment make, model, serial number and part number. We will check fitment where we can, but we are not liable for loss caused by wrong information supplied by the buyer.

4. Delivery, risk and title

Delivery dates are estimates. Risk passes according to the Incoterms 2020 rule in the quotation (or on collection or delivery where none applies). Title to the goods passes only when we have received full payment. See the Shipping and delivery section.

5. Inspection

Inspect goods on delivery and tell us in writing within 3 working days of any shortage, damage or wrong item, with photos and the delivery note.

6. Limitation of liability

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, including lost production, downtime or lost profit. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the price paid for the goods concerned. Nothing here excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law, or any rights you have under Zambian consumer or sale-of-goods law.

7. Safe use and compliance

Equipment, lifting gear, pressure parts, fuel equipment and electrical items must be installed, tested and operated by competent people in line with the manufacturer’s instructions and applicable Zambian safety, mining and environmental rules. We do not supply explosives or blasting agents.

8. Force majeure

We are not in breach for delay caused by events outside our reasonable control, including supplier or shipping delays, border or port disruption, strikes, government action and natural events.

9. Governing law and disputes

These terms are governed by the laws of Zambia. The parties will first try to settle disputes through good-faith discussion, and then through the Zambian courts, unless a written contract agrees otherwise.

10. Online orders

Orders placed through the online shop are made on Shopify’s checkout. The price and terms shown at checkout, together with these terms, apply. We may cancel and refund an order that cannot be fulfilled, or that was priced in error, before dispatch. Optional insurance cover is arranged separately as described on the product page and is subject to the insurer’s policy terms.

shipping.title: Shipping, delivery and Incoterms
shipping.html:
Goods are supplied under the Incoterms 2020 rule named in the quotation (for example EXW, FCA, CFR or DAP). Where DAP applies, we deliver to the agreed site entrance; unloading is your responsibility unless quoted separately.

Import duties, VAT, clearing and port charges are included only where the quotation says so. Imported items may be subject to Zambia Revenue Authority clearance, and delays at ports and borders can change lead times. Lead times in a quotation are estimates, not guarantees.

Abnormal, oversized or hazardous loads need permits and special transport, which we will quote separately. Fuel, chemicals and similar goods are supplied only in line with the licensing and safety rules that apply to them.

returns.title: Returns, warranty and refunds
returns.html:
Warranty

New goods carry the manufacturer’s or supplier’s warranty, passed on to you. The warranty period and conditions are stated on the quotation or invoice. Aftermarket parts carry the warranty of their maker unless we state otherwise. Warranty does not cover wear and tear, misuse, wrong installation, lack of maintenance, wrong lubricants or fluids, or use outside rated limits.

Returns

Faulty, damaged or wrong items reported within 3 working days will be repaired, replaced or credited, subject to supplier inspection. Special-order, cut-to-length, custom-made, electrical, opened or fitted items cannot be returned for change of mind. Items we agree to take back must be unused, in original packaging, with proof of purchase, and may carry a restocking fee.

Refunds

Approved refunds are paid to the original payment method within a reasonable time after we receive and inspect the goods.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.html:
Hydraumatics General Dealers is the data controller for personal data collected through this website. We handle personal data in line with the Data Protection Act, 2021 of Zambia.

What we collect

Your name, job title, company, email address, phone number and the details of your request. This site does not collect payment card details. Our hosting provider (Cloudflare) processes technical data such as IP address to deliver and protect the site. Quote requests are passed to our email through the Web3Forms form service.

Newsletter

If you subscribe to our newsletter we collect your email address, optional name and interests, the time you subscribed and the wording you agreed to. We use them only to send the newsletter you asked for. Our legal basis is your consent, which you can withdraw at any time using the unsubscribe link in every email or by emailing news@hgdmachines.online. We keep subscriber records until you unsubscribe, plus a short record that you did so, so we do not email you again. Subscriptions are stored in our database hosted by Cloudflare, and a confirmation email may be sent by our email provider. You can unsubscribe at hgdmachines.online/unsubscribe.

Browser storage

The online shop stores a cart identifier in your browser so your cart is remembered. See Cookies and browser storage.

Why we use it

To prepare quotations, process orders and deliveries, keep tax and accounting records, deal with warranty claims and answer your enquiries. Our legal bases are your consent, performing a contract with you, our legal obligations and our legitimate business interests.

Who we share it with

Suppliers, freight and clearing agents, payment providers, IT, hosting and email providers (including Cloudflare, which hosts this site and the database where enquiries and newsletter subscriptions are stored, and our email and web form providers), and authorities where the law requires. Some providers may process data outside Zambia; we require them to protect it appropriately. We do not sell personal data.

How long we keep it

Enquiries and quotation requests that do not lead to a sale for up to 24 months. For spam protection we briefly keep a scrambled (hashed) form of your connection address for 24 hours. Order, invoice and tax records for at least the period required by Zambian law.

Your rights

You may ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to or restrict its use, and withdraw consent at any time. Email support@hgdmachines.online or info@hgdmachines.online. You may also complain to the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner.

Security

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data. Email is not fully secure, so avoid sending sensitive information that is not needed for a quotation.

Online shop orders

Orders placed through our online shop are processed on Shopify’s secure checkout. Shopify and its payment providers process your contact, delivery and payment details under their own privacy terms. We do not see or store your full card details.

newsletter.title: Newsletter terms
newsletter.html:
Our newsletter is optional. By subscribing you agree to receive occasional emails from Hydraumatics General Dealers about products, supply updates, safety information and company news.

We send it only to people who have asked for it. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any email, at hgdmachines.online/unsubscribe, or by emailing news@hgdmachines.online. Unsubscribing does not affect quotations, orders or service messages you need to receive, such as order updates.

We do not sell or rent subscriber details. How we handle them is described in the Privacy notice.

insurance.title: Insurance information
insurance.html:
Some products offer optional insurance cover, for example overseas freight, inland road transport, storage and handling, and delivery to site. Cover is optional and is separate from the sale of the goods.

Who provides it

Cover is arranged with a licensed insurer or insurance intermediary. Hydraumatics General Dealers is not itself an insurer. The premium shown is the charge for the cover selected. The insurer’s policy wording, cover limit, excess or deductible, exclusions and claims procedure apply, and are available to you on request and with your order confirmation.

Choosing a cover limit

Choose a cover limit at least equal to the value of your goods. If the limit is lower than the value, a claim may be reduced. Cover may not be available for every item, route or destination. If we cannot arrange cover you selected, we will tell you and refund the premium.

If something goes wrong

Tell us and the carrier in writing as soon as possible, keep the packaging, take photographs and keep the delivery note. Email support@hgdmachines.online. Complaints about cover can be made to us first and then to the insurer.

Insurance does not change your rights under the Terms of sale or any rights you have by law.

cookies.title: Cookies and browser storage
cookies.html:
This site does not use advertising or analytics cookies and does not track you across other sites.

What is stored in your browser

  • Cart identifier (local storage): remembers your shopping cart on this device. It is necessary for the shop to work and contains no personal details.
  • Theme (local storage): remembers your light or dark choice if you use the theme switch. Otherwise the site follows your device setting.

Third parties

When you go to checkout, Shopify’s checkout page sets the cookies it needs to process your order securely, under Shopify’s own policies. Our hosting provider, Cloudflare, may set security cookies to protect the site. If we add analytics or other cookies later, we will update this page and ask for your consent where required.

You can clear stored data or block cookies in your browser settings; the cart and checkout may then not work as expected.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.html:
We want everyone to be able to use this website, including people who use screen readers, keyboards, voice control or magnification, and people on slow connections or small screens.

We build to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 level AA and test pages automatically in several browsers and in light and dark display modes. Automated testing does not find every problem, so we also check with assistive technology. Some parts, such as supplier-provided product images, may have limited descriptions.

If you have difficulty using any part of the site, or need information in another format, email support@hgdmachines.online and we will help you place an enquiry or order another way.
